_source: Fragment costs + multiplier formula: datamined values as published by the community damage calcs, cross-checked vs Fextralife's per-level negation table. Multipliers are generated by ERCalc.scadutree() — attack ×(1+0.05·L), taken ×1/(1+0.05·L). '(verify)' marks community claims not re-confirmed in-game.
intro: Scadutree Blessing is the DLC's real leveling. It only works in the Land of Shadow, and it dwarfs character levels there: at blessing 20 you deal double damage and take half.
costNote: 50 fragments reach blessing 20. Spend them at any Site of Grace.

revered.title: Revered Spirit Ash (the summon version)
notes: The same idea for your Spirit Ashes and Torrent: collect Revered Spirit Ash, spend at a Grace, max level 10.
≈ +5% summon damage per level, with damage taken reduced on a similar curve. (verify exact per-level values)
If you fight with a Mimic Tear, this is half your DLC power budget — don't ignore it.

whereToFind: Churches and ruined chapels almost always hold a Scadutree Fragment at the Marika statue — check every one.
Miquella's Crosses (the big golden crosses) usually hold Revered Spirit Ash — same habit, check every one.
Minor bosses, field commanders, and Shadow Keep's interior carry several apiece — the wiki's interactive map lists every spot.
Hunting fragments IS the difficulty slider: stuck on a boss → go collect two levels and it's a different fight.
